name: mastermind-mod
description: Optional Claude Code mod for MasterMind: asks before irreversible actions, shows the brain's status, and flags answers that claim completion without a verdict. Runs code inside Claude Code; read the README first.

hold.title: Irreversible-action hold
hold.description: all, destructive-only or off. all asks before anything that cannot be undone or that leaves this machine. destructive-only skips plain push, publish and deploy. off disables the hold.

headless.title: Hold when nobody can be asked
headless.description: defer or deny. defer leaves the decision to your permission rules under claude -p and the SDK. deny refuses the command.

handoffAt.title: Handoff hint at context percent
handoffAt.description: Show one handoff hint when the context window is this full. 0 turns the hint off.

nudge.title: Verdict and evidence notices
nudge.description: on or off. on shows a one-line notice when an answer claims completion without a verdict, reports a check that never ran, or sends a review to a fork.
